summary: Franco-Nevada Corporation filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release dated September 28, 2026, announcing that President and CEO Paul Brink was appointed Chair of the World Gold Council, the gold mining industry association. No securities, ownership stake, price per share, premium, transaction value, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is stated, and the filing contains no merger, tender, divestiture, activist, or capital-return event. This is a routine governance and industry-appointment disclosure, not a special situation, offering no deal terms or risk-arb angle.
